title: Adaptive adversarial validation of the canonical temporal-reference gate

timing.note: Start is the first intervention commit time; end is the timestamp of the final exact-head review receipt posted to PR 56.

deviations: The counterexamples and fixes were generated adaptively after inspecting each preceding review outcome; this is development evidence, not a preregistered or confirmatory test.
The final checkout had an ignored/untracked local virtual environment, but no tracked source or result change was present.
The independent reviewer was gpt-daybreak-blue-latest at high reasoning effort operating ordinary git, gh, pytest, Python, code, document, and artifact tools. It was not a human or blinded reviewer.
Codex Security plugins, skills, MCP tools, and automated security-scan phases were explicitly excluded from review rounds after the user's instruction.
Track X v0.1 changes are a post-hoc downstream schema intervention and are not attributed to the frozen raw verifier.

dataset.name: Synthetic canonical temporal-reference adversaries and frozen repository conformance artifacts
dataset.split: adaptive development cases plus unchanged fixed canonical and Track X artifacts

models.claim_boundary: model-assisted independent tool execution, not human peer review

controls.manual_review_tool_boundary: ordinary repository and test tools only; no Codex Security workflow
controls.outcome_access: Each review round informed the next patch; no held-out confirmation claim is permitted.

results.primary_outcome: No blocking counterexample remained at exact head after four adaptive manual review rounds.

correction_chain.findings: 11 omitted missing/future reference routes, claim/evidence namespace confusion, and an undisclosed Track X artifact change
future same-ID claim ambiguity, claim-policy contamination of evidence, and inconsistent incomplete snapshot-member handling
empty snapshot/object identifiers were accepted by the shared validator, Gold, and Generic but rejected by Typed
none blocking within the enumerated finite-runtime contract

cost.note: Local deterministic execution and subscription-based Codex review; no DeepSeek or other metered model API call was made. Codex token usage was not exposed or dollar-attributed.

artifact_retention.reason: The four detailed manual reports remain in the local Codex visualization store and are hash-addressed here; durable repository evidence is the committed regression suite, deterministic artifacts, CI receipt, PR history, and this aggregate record.

claim_boundary: Adaptive development validation of the enumerated finite CommonEvent temporal-reference contract at PR 56 exact head. It is not a confirmatory result, an independent human review, a benchmark score, evidence of three independent validators, or proof of standalone Snapshot lifecycle, global identifier grammar, durable-store enforcement, or complete valid-time causality.
